Install visual-studio-code on Omarchy

Visual Studio Code is a free code editor from Microsoft with built-in debugging, Git integration, an integrated terminal, and IntelliSense completions, extendable through a marketplace of tens of thousands of extensions covering nearly every language and framework. Recent versions add AI coding agents that can plan and carry out multi-step edits, run commands, and iterate, on top of the traditional editing experience.

Watch: Learn Visual Studio Code in 15 minutes: 2026 Official Beginner Tutorial ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add visual-studio-code-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.143.1-1:
    pacman -Qi visual-studio-code-bin

Open and use visual-studio-code

visual-studio-code is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql visual-studio-code-bin | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install visual-studio-code on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add visual-studio-code-bin. The download is 332.4 MB and it takes 1 GB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is visual-studio-code free?

Free to use (Free binary; Microsoft's own build under a proprietary (non-OSS) license, distinct from the open-source Code - OSS project). The package is licensed custom: commercial.

How do I uninstall visual-studio-code?

Run omarchy pkg drop visual-studio-code-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does visual-studio-code depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: libxkbfile, gnupg, gtk3, libsecret, nss, gcc-libs, libnotify, libxss, glibc, lsof, shared-mime-info, xdg-utils and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is visual-studio-code a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for visual-studio-code.

Is visual-studio-code in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as visual-studio-code-bin (version 1.143.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Microsoft makes it. Project site: https://code.visualstudio.com/.
